subject: Brightline pre-launch: quota bump & traffic model coordination
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@brightline.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightline pre-launch: initial traffic forecast and quota ask

Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're targeting a staged public launch the week of May 11 and wanted to give you an initial traffic projection so we can lock in quota and any temporary rate-limit exceptions. High-level numbers below (we'll attach the detailed model):

- Day 0 (soft launch internal): 10k requests/day
- Week 1 peak: 120k requests/day across chat & embeddings
- Expected 95th percentile concurrent requests: ~420 TPS (short bursts)

Requesting a temporary dedicated quota bump to support 500 TPS for the launch week and ideally a short runway (2–3 weeks) to validate. We're also open to a canary approach if you prefer staged routing.

Attached: Brightline_launch_traffic_model.xlsx and our mutual action plan. Can we get an internal owner for quota coordination and a rough timeline for approvals?

—Alex
Chief Product Officer
Brightline Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline pre-launch: initial traffic forecast and quota ask

Alex —

Thanks for the model, this is helpful. Marissa and I will own coordination from the account side. Karthik, looping you for an initial feasibility check: do the figures below look plausible from a product/throughput perspective? If this goes to 500 TPS bursts we may need routing rules + a temporary rate-limit policy change.

Two quick asks from us while we triage:
1) Can you confirm the traffic mix (chat vs. embeddings) per your spreadsheet? Embeddings are more cost/throughput sensitive.
2) Any hard SLOs on latency during peak?

I'll also bring infra on Monday to scope the SLA/exception form.

Hannah
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline pre-launch: initial traffic forecast and quota ask

On Mon, Apr 13, 2026 at 08:05 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex —
>
> Thanks for the model, this is helpful. Marissa and I will own coordination from the account side. Karthik, looping you for an initial feasibility check...

Quick read of the attached spreadsheet — numbers look like a heavy mix of chat generation (~70%) and a smaller embeddings workload (~30%) during peaks. Two implications:

- Chat spikes will drive GPU-milli throughput and KV cache pressure; 500 TPS bursts are non-trivial but doable with dedicated capacity or temporary routing to higher-capacity pools.
- Embeddings at high volume can blow through token quotas if not batched/quantized — we'll want to ensure client-side batching and a short TTL cache on responses.

Action items for product/infra:
- Dev: run a capacity preflight against a representative model at the requested burst profile and confirm whether we hit any kernel-level bottlenecks. If so, propose a temporary model variant (e.g., FP16 quantized) or route to dedicated pool.
- Marcus: flag any product constraints (model variant availability, rollout conflicts) — is May 11 realistic for a temporary exception?

I recommend a short canary: route 10% traffic to target pool for the first 24 hours then scale to 50/100% based on observed latencies. If acceptable, we can formalize that in the mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf.

-karthik
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 12:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline pre-launch: initial traffic forecast and quota ask

Karthik + team —

I'll run a preflight against the requested burst profile first thing tomorrow. Quick notes after a baseline run with the same model family at 400 TPS bursts:

- We saw KV cache pressure causing tail latency spikes after ~7 minutes of sustained bursts; auto-eviction tuning helps but isn't perfect.
- If Brightline can enable client-side prefix caching for repeated prompts, we can reduce token throughput significantly.
- For a short runway (2–3 weeks): we can grant a temporary quota bump to 500 TPS but it needs an SLA exception (attached sla-exception-form.docx) and a runbook for rollback.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 04/14: infra preflight + recommend routing policy (dedicated vs. burst to shared high-capacity pool)
- Wed 04/15: legal/finance signoff on SLA exception and usage terms (Marissa to coordinate)
- Fri 04/17: final smoke test with 10% canary

I'll include required metrics to monitor (CPU/GPU utilization, KV hit rate, 95/99 latency) in the runbook.

-dev
Infra Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@brightline.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline pre-launch: initial traffic forecast and quota ask

Alex —

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the forecast. Per Dev and Karthik we can support a temporary 500 TPS quota for the launch window with the planned canary approach. Next steps from the commercial side:

- I'll send a short MSA addendum covering temporary overage liability and a 2-week pilot pricing uplift.
- Please countersign the mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf so we can schedule the canary and smoke test on Fri 04/17.
- FYI: finance will require usage visibility (daily reports) and a contact for incident triage — please confirm who at Brightline will be on-call during launch.

If you can confirm client batching and who will be on-call, we'll kick off infra's preflight tomorrow.

Thanks!
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Director
Redwood Inference
